description: Addendum to ALREADY ACCEPTED v8.18d5 portable 684-week MVRV as-of ledger: quantify temporal sparseness, label maturity, 13/26/52-week greedy window separation from source dates only.
method: Read exactly pinned canonical v8.18d5 and BTCI v8.17.1 from R2 with SHA256 full-body verification, no merge or recount from raw Coin Metrics.

Verify all 684 dates sorted ascending, unique Sundays; original canonical as-of witnesses exactly 26, not 658 others; research-only parent. Each old as-of MVRV has public UTC timestamp before Sunday and feature date age 2..7d.

Use panel LAST Sunday strictly as maturity cutoff for horizons, with mature when Sunday + H*7 days <= last panel date. This is only a conservative label-window upper bound; does not assert labels are actually available or correct.

For each horizon, compute dated witnesses with mature outcome windows, and greedy chronological subset: select earliest mature witness, next if date >= prior selected + H*7 days. Also compute greedy subset on all 26 (unmatured potential separately).

No future return values, BTC price paths, overlapping-return estimates, coefficients, reweighting, threshold fits, P&L or prediction. Temporal separation by H weeks is NOT proof of independent events.
This is not canonical v8.18d5 modification, archived under separately numbered 8.18d5a report.
R2 research prefix PUT+GET SHA256 report and manifest, portable date-count only, no source CSV redistribution.
